title: Risk assessment
text: The supplier shall carry out and document a risk assessment covering all life phases of the machine and deliver it to the buyer before FAT.

title: CE marking and EU declaration of conformity
text: The machine shall bear the CE marking and be delivered with an EU declaration of conformity issued under Regulation (EU) 2023/1230.

title: Instructions for use
text: Instructions for use shall be provided in Swedish and English. Digital instructions are accepted; a paper copy shall be supplied on request.

title: Technical documentation package
text: The supplier shall deliver electrical, hydraulic and pneumatic schematics, a complete parts list and layout drawings in editable format.

title: Marking plate
text: The machine shall carry a durable marking plate with manufacturer name and address, designation, type, serial number and year of construction.

title: Safety signs
text: Warning and mandatory-action signs shall use ISO 7010 pictograms.

title: Isolation of energy sources
text: Every energy source shall be isolatable by a device that can be locked in the isolated position.

title: Maintenance outside danger zones
text: Adjustment, lubrication and maintenance points shall be located outside danger zones.

title: Lighting
text: Integral lighting shall be provided where the absence of it could cause a risk at operating or maintenance positions.

title: Ergonomics
text: Loading and operating positions shall be designed to avoid awkward postures and allow for operator body dimensions.

title: Spare parts availability
text: Spare parts shall be available for at least 10 years after delivery, and a recommended spare parts list shall be delivered.

title: Training
text: The supplier shall provide sufficient training for operators and maintenance staff on site, at least 1 day.

title: Factory and site acceptance tests
text: A factory acceptance test (FAT) and a site acceptance test (SAT) shall be performed together with the buyer according to an agreed test protocol.

title: Warranty
text: The warranty period shall be at least 24 months from SAT approval.

title: Instructions on data carrier
text: Instructions shall be supplied on CD-ROM in addition to paper.

title: Acceptance testing
text: The machine shall pass a factory acceptance test at the supplier and a site acceptance test at the buyer, both witnessed by the buyer.

title: Electrical equipment
text: Electrical equipment shall comply with EN 60204-1.

title: Electrical hazards
text: The machine shall be designed to prevent all hazards of an electrical nature.

title: Main disconnecting switch
text: A main disconnecting switch shall be provided that can be locked in the off position.

title: Electromagnetic compatibility
text: The machine shall comply with the EMC Directive 2014/30/EU.

title: Cabinet protection class
text: Control cabinets shall have protection class IP54 or higher.

title: Lockable main switch
text: The machine shall have a lockable main disconnecting switch so it can be isolated in the off position.

title: Restart after power failure
text: Restoration of power after an interruption shall not cause an unexpected start.

title: Guards for moving parts
text: Moving parts that can cause injury shall be prevented from being reached by guards or protective devices.

title: Fixed guards
text: Fixed guards shall only be removable with tools and their fixings shall remain attached to the guard or machine.

title: Interlocking movable guards
text: Movable guards shall be interlocked so that hazardous functions cannot start while the guard is open and stop when it is opened.

title: Safety distances
text: Safety distances to prevent danger zones being reached shall follow EN ISO 13857.

title: Ejection of parts
text: Protection shall be provided against fragments or test objects ejected if they rupture or break loose.

title: Safety-related control functions
text: Safety functions shall be designed to EN ISO 13849-1 with the performance level determined in the risk assessment, and a calculation report shall be delivered.

title: Emergency stop
text: The machine shall be fitted with emergency stop devices according to EN ISO 13850 at each operating position.

title: Deliberate start
text: Starting the machine shall only be possible by deliberate action on a control device provided for that purpose.

title: Mode selection
text: Where several operating modes exist, mode selection shall be lockable and each mode shall override all other control modes except emergency stop.

title: Software and source code
text: PLC and safety PLC programs shall be delivered with source code, comments and a backup procedure.

title: HMI usability
text: The HMI shall be user-friendly and intuitive.

title: Evidence of software interventions
text: Safety-relevant software and configuration changes shall be logged so that interventions can be traced.

title: Protection against corruption
text: Connection of another device or remote access shall not lead to a hazardous situation; hardware and software components critical for safety shall be protected against corruption.

title: Remote access solution
text: Remote access shall only use the buyer-approved remote access solution; supplier-owned routers or permanent VPN tunnels are not permitted.

title: Industrial cybersecurity
text: Networked control components shall meet the IEC 62443 security level agreed with the buyer.

title: Hydraulic systems
text: Hydraulic systems shall comply with EN ISO 4413.

title: Hose whip protection
text: Pressurised hoses near operating positions shall be shielded or restrained against whipping on failure.

title: Stored energy
text: Residual pressure in hydraulic and pneumatic circuits shall be dissipated or isolatable, with pressure indication.

title: Oil containment
text: An adequate drip tray shall be provided under the hydraulic power unit.

title: Pneumatic systems
text: Pneumatic systems shall comply with EN ISO 4414.

title: Exhaust silencers
text: Pneumatic exhausts shall be fitted with silencers.

title: Extreme temperatures
text: Steps shall be taken to eliminate any risk of injury from contact with or proximity to machine parts or materials at high or very low temperatures.

title: Fire
text: The machine shall be designed to avoid any risk of fire or overheating posed by the machine itself or by materials used or produced.

title: Noise emission
text: Noise shall be reduced at source and the declared emission values shall be stated in the instructions.

title: Noise at operator position
text: The A-weighted sound pressure level at the operator position shall not exceed 80 dB(A).

title: Workplace noise
text: The sound pressure level at the operator position shall not exceed 75 dB(A).

title: Robot systems
text: Robot systems and cells shall comply with EN ISO 10218-2.

title: Collaborative operation
text: If collaborative operation is used, force and pressure limits shall follow ISO/TS 15066.

title: Handling and lifting points
text: The machine and heavy test objects shall have marked lifting points or be designed for safe handling with lifting equipment.

title: Integrated lifting equipment
text: Integrated lifting equipment shall meet the supplementary requirements for lifting operations.

title: Pressure equipment
text: Pressure equipment and assemblies shall comply with the Pressure Equipment Directive 2014/68/EU where applicable.

title: Explosion protection
text: The machine shall be designed to avoid any risk of explosion; equipment in potentially explosive atmospheres shall comply with ATEX Directive 2014/34/EU.

title: Leak and gas detection
text: Test cells handling flammable fluids shall have leak or vapour detection that triggers automatic shutdown.

title: Slipping, tripping and falling
text: Surfaces where operators move or stand shall be designed to prevent slipping, tripping and falling.

title: Setting mode with guards open
text: Where operators must work with guards open for setting, movements shall only be possible with an enabling device at reduced speed.
